meta.face: A small, lean man of about seventy, clean-shaven, with a narrow, bony, triangular face — a broad, domed, bald head with only a small tuft of white hair over the brow and a thin white fringe, prominent cheekbones over sunken cheeks, a long, thin, slightly hooked nose, small, deep-set, lively dark eyes under sparse grey brows, thin lips and a small pointed chin; weathered, ascetic but cheerful and alert, looking out with fervour.
meta.basis: Bartolomeo Vivarini's portrait of 1459, three years after his death (Louvre), shows an old, bald, clean-shaven, gaunt friar in grey with a cross-banner; a contemporary called him 'small of body, withered, emaciated, nothing but skin and bone, but cheerful, strong and strenuous in labor'. Idealised to lean and bright-eyed; Belgrade kept at a peaceful distance.
